assertions: The prominent Result download uses the shared large 44px desktop role and retains the shared 48px phone target.
Initial assembly without a displayed result keeps a stage footprint at English and Russian short desktop and phone sizes.
Replacement assembly and retained-result failure stay compact beside the previous playable result at English and Russian short desktop and phone sizes; no second stage is rendered.
The prior result remains playable, visibly labeled as the previous version, and keeps its media identity when replacement assembly or failure is shown.
First descriptor failure shows a retryable error without a player; retry calls the same generation ID and makes no assembly or credit calls.
Russian unknown-download action wraps within the 390px phone content width; document scroll width remains 390px.

While generation 1 is pending, Watch new remains available; generation 2 can be downloaded; generation 1 retry still requests generation 1; no assembly or credit calls. Browser download events prove request delivery only, not completed OS saving.
The new-version announcement uses the shared sr-only utility and contributes no visible duplicate line.
